reviewMethod: Individual reading and editorial assessment of each final prompt. Whole-catalogue exact, TF-IDF and LSA candidate retrieval informs semantic adjudication. AI provenance remains separate from human approval.
similarityAdjudication: Individually read final 200 for group participation, relationship focus, varied openings and voluntary personal disclosure. Replaced spaciousness, social re-entry, mediation, competition, inexperience, unfinished ideas and defending independent choices because existing content led to substantially the same discussion. Also diversified introductions, updating impressions and group influence into public visibility, online familiarity, language barriers, shared venues, success and opportunity sharing. Remaining retrieval flags concern materially different angles such as status barriers versus belittling, silence versus general comfort, and attention without exposure versus attention which slows someone down. LSA candidates were treated as fallible retrieval rather than proof.
